review_method: Assistant reviewed official PDF specification text; representative multi-column and connectivity pages visually checked. Not an independent human audit.

fields.usb_c_video: Video input through USB-C/Thunderbolt upstream connector using DP Alt Mode. A data-only USB-C or downstream charging port does not qualify.
fields.usb_c_pd_watts: Maximum host/laptop charging power on the video upstream port. Zero means that this host video+charging function is not provided; downstream charging is recorded separately.
fields.max_refresh_hz: Maximum preset refresh at the recorded native resolution, with a supported input and host. Not a guarantee for every cable/host.
fields.screen_inches: Viewable diagonal as stated in the manual; not rounded to the marketed size class.
